datasheet_identity.title: BZT52B2V4 THRU BZT52B51 SURFACE MOUNT ZENER DIODES

extraction_notes: Zener-voltage range for BZT52B13 is 12.74 V minimum, 13 V nominal, and 13.26 V maximum at IZT = 5 mA and TA = 25 degC; breakdown_voltage records the nominal typical value.
Maximum zener impedance is 30 ohm at IZT = 5 mA; maximum knee impedance is 170 ohm at IZK = 1 mA, p. 2.
Admissible zener current IZM is 5 mA and temperature coefficient range is 7.0 to 11.0 mV/degC at IZTC = 5 mA, p. 2.
The datasheet publishes no reverse-recovery-time value.
Curve points are manual reads from the supplied typical family plots. The zener trace is explicitly labeled 13; the capacitance trace is the 0 V bias family curve evaluated at nominal VZ = 13 V.
extraction.omission_reason: No reverse-recovery-time value is published. Other required electrical fields were available from the table or typical family plots.
